original_card.question: Does a new paid-profile or mixture-ceiling claim have independent source-bound coverage of its actual changed ledger?
methods: Independently reconstruct one changed paid ledger or pooled dual with exact source and model binding.
Check a genuinely uncovered moment implication with a different enclosure method and semantic controls.
original_card.acceptance_gate: Demonstrate independence, source binding, positive cases and semantic failure controls. Name the existing checks and the missing coverage. More digits or another equivalent evaluation of an unchanged root is not by itself new verification coverage.

first_step.inspect: Choose one uncovered implication in #4088 literal mixed fill, #4091 pooled dual/model binding or #4067 changed frame/host bill. #4091 pins an earlier #4088 head: validate word, capacity and stock equivalence before applying that ceiling to the later fill.
first_step.scope: Source-binding orientation only; no scientific replay, theorem acceptance or supplier admission. Budget any heavy replay separately.

original_card.first_experiment: Independently reconstruct one changed ledger or pooled certificate with a positive case and a semantic failure control. Compare exact sources and name what existing checks miss. Keep this separate from supplier-boundary-audit (ordinary/outer dispatch) and uniform-transfer-audit (all-size proof). Stop after the chosen implication; more digits of an unchanged root are not additional mechanism coverage.
original_card.bottleneck_link: Independent pricing prevents unsupported frontier claims and can reveal genuine accounting slack.

actual_scope: Prove the exact asymptotic ratio of the stated Lagrangian projection recurrence for every fixed nonnegative seed profile, with an explicit convergence bound; apply it to the cited block-four seed to obtain 439277/149175.
scope_change_reason: The card requests independent paid-ledger coverage. This contribution instead gives an original closed-form limit theorem for the complex small-block projection recurrence of Sussman #4628 and Lutz #4643; their inputs are cited premises and are not replayed as the deliverable.
bottleneck_link: Scoped complex small-block side result: it identifies exactly the asymptotic output of this lower-bound recurrence and preserves its unresolved hook and engine premises. It changes no selected supplier or kappa.
stop_rule: Stop at the first proved exact limit and convergence theorem; do not extend into hook-rank certification, finite-m optimization or a physical construction.
evidence: PROOF.md proves the general rational limit and equation (1) error bound. verify.py checks new kernel/coherence/normalization identities, independent integer/probability propagation, exact limit enclosures and six controls. RESULT.json is generated and hash-bound.
author: Nick Petalas

open_questions.why_it_matters: The exact limit now has a rational formula, while the explicit coupling estimate is conservative.
open_questions.first_step: Study the coherent Lagrangian distance laws and the finite product of deficit kernels for a fixed seed.
open_questions.blocked_by: No blocker identified; a new finite-m identity is needed.

open_questions.first_step: Express adjacent-block differences as linear functionals of the seed and identify their sign cone.
open_questions.blocked_by: No monotonicity or finite-m infimum theorem is supplied.
